sections.heading: Our Story
sections.text: Welcome to our store. We believe in quality, design, and sustainable practices. Founded in 2026, we aim to bring you the best curated fashion without compromise.

sections.heading: Our Commitment
sections.text: Every piece in our catalog is thoughtfully selected for versatility, comfort, and lasting style.

sections.heading: Standard Shipping
sections.text: Free standard shipping on orders over $75. Orders ship within 1-2 business days and typically arrive in 3-5 business days.

sections.heading: International Delivery
sections.text: We ship internationally across Europe, UK, Canada, and Asia-Pacific. Rates and duties are calculated at checkout.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your data security is our priority.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.text: We collect information necessary to process your order, including name, email, and shipping address.

sections.heading: Data Protection
sections.text: We respect your privacy. We never sell or share your personal data with third parties.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.text: By accessing and placing an order with our store, you agree to be bound by these terms.

sections.heading: How do I return an item?
sections.text: Reach out to returns@yourbrand.com within 30 days of delivery to initiate a hassle-free return.

sections.heading: When will my order ship?
sections.text: Orders process within 1-2 business days. You will receive a tracking link as soon as your package ships.
